subject: King Lorik
text: King Lorik instructs the hero to take items from the treasure chests and speak to the guards to aid in defeating the Dragonlord.

evidence.quote:
Take now whatever
thou may find in these Treasure Chests to aid thee in thy quest. Then
speak with the guards, for they have much knowledge that may aid thee.

subject: Guard
text: A guard in Tantagel Castle advises that a town east of the castle sells equipment and resting at an inn heals wounds.

evidence.quote:
East of this castle is a town where armor, weapons, and many
other items may be purchased. Return to the Inn for a rest if thou are
wounded in battle, [You]. Sleep heals all.

subject: Magic Key
text: A key found in the treasure chests will disappear upon being used to unlock a door.

evidence.quote:
If thou hast collected all the Treasure Chests, a key will
be found. Once used, the key will disappear but the door will be open
and thou may pass through.

subject: Imperial Scroll
text: King Lorik records the player's deeds in his Imperial Scroll to save game progress.

evidence.quote:
King Lorik will record thy deeds in his Imperial Scroll so
thou may return to thy quest later.

subject: Torch
text: A guard in Tantagel Castle advises taking a torch when entering a cave.

evidence.quote: When entering the cave, take with thee a torch.

subject: Princess Gwaelin
text: Princess Gwaelin gives her love to the hero after being rescued and returned to Tantagel Castle.

evidence.quote: Princess - "Wait a moment, please. I would like to give a present to [You]. Please accept my love, QuickMan. Even when we two are parted by great distances, I shall be with thee.

subject: Rainbow Bridge
text: Legend states that when the sun and rain meet, a Rainbow Bridge will appear.

evidence.quote:
When the sun and rain meet, a Rainbow Bridge shall appear.
It's a legend.

subject: Garin's Grave
text: A knight reveals that in Garinham one must push on a wall of darkness at the grave of Garin.

evidence.quote:
In Garinham, look for the grave of Garin. Thou must
push on a wall of darkness there.

subject: Castle Cellar
text: A knight mentions searching for the cellar in Tantagel Castle, which is not easily found.

evidence.quote:
I am looking for the castle cellar. I heard it is not
easily found.

subject: Garinham
text: A citizen in Brecconary directs travelers north to the seashore and then west along the coastline to reach Garinham.

evidence.quote:
Go north to the seashore, then follow the coastline west until
thou hath reached Garniham.

subject: Charlock
text: Charlock, the fortress of the Dragonlord, is located south of Tantagel Castle within sight.

evidence.quote:
Within sight of Tantagel Castle to the south is Charlock, the
fortress of the Dragonlord.

subject: Magic Key
text: A man in Brecconary notes there is a town where magic keys can be purchased.

evidence.quote: There is a town where magic keys can be purchased.

subject: Poisonous Marsh
text: An old man in Brecconary warns travelers to watch their Hit Points when in the Poisonous Marsh.

evidence.quote: Watch thy Hit Points when in the Poisonous Marsh.

subject: Princess Gwaelin
text: Townspeople in Garinham believe Princess Gwaelin was kidnapped, taken eastward, and hidden away in a cave.

evidence.quote:
Many believe that Princess Gwaelin is hidden away in a
cave....It is said that the Princess was kidnapped and taken
eastward.

subject: Erdrick's Armor
text: An old man in Garinham mentions that Erdrick's armor was hidden long ago.

evidence.quote: They say that Erdrick's armor was hidden long ago.

subject: Silver Harp
text: An old man in Garinham warns that playing the harp attracts enemies.

evidence.quote:
The harp attracts enemies. Stay away from the grave in
Garinham.

subject: Hauksness
text: A man in Garinham mentions that the town of Hauksness once existed far to the south.

evidence.quote:
Once there was a town called Hauksness far to the south, but I
do not know if it still exists.

subject: Golem
text: Legends state that fairies know how to put the Golem to sleep.

evidence.quote:
In legends, it is said that fairies know how to put Golem
to sleep.

subject: Weapons
text: A knight reports that extraordinary quality weapons can be purchased in a town east of Hauksness.

evidence.quote:
East of Hauksness there is a town, 'tis said, where one
may purchase weapons of extraordinary quality.

subject: Rimuldar
text: A villager in Kol notes that the town of Rimuldar lies to the south.

evidence.quote:
To the south, I believe,
there is a town called Rimuldar.

subject: Fairy Flute
text: An elder in Kol reveals that Howard had the flute before traveling to Rimuldar.

evidence.quote: Howard had it, but he went to Rimuldar and never returned.

subject: Southern Island
text: A man in Rimuldar warns not to travel to the south because the monsters there are fierce and terrible.

evidence.quote:
Heed my warning! Travel not to the south for there the
monsters are fierce and terrible.

subject: Stones of Sunlight
text: A guard in Rimuldar reveals that the Stones of Sunlight can be found in Tantagel Castle.

evidence.quote:
Thou shalt find the Stones of Sunlight in Tantegel Castle is
thou has not found them yet.

subject: Charlock
text: An old man mentions that Erdrick created a rainbow over the western part of the island and entered darkness via a hidden entrance in the Dragonlord's room.

evidence.quote:
Over the western part of this island, Erdrick created a
rainbow. 'Tis also said that he entered the darkness from a hidden
entrance in the room of the Dragonlord.

subject: Magic Temple
text: An old man explains that the sun and rain meet in the magic temple located to the south.

evidence.quote: In this temple do sun and rain meet....Go to the south.

subject: Fairy Flute
text: Howard reveals that a magic item is hidden four steps south of the bath in Kol.

evidence.quote:
Good day, I am Howard. Four steps south of the bath in Kol
thou shalt find a magic item.

subject: Wynn
text: A guard in Cantlin states that a fellow named Wynn was the last person to hold Erdrick's armor.

evidence.quote:
It is said that many have held Erdrick's armor. The last to
have it was a fellow named Wynn.

subject: Erdrick's Token
text: An elder directs the hero to search 70 leagues to the south and 40 to the east from Tantagel Castle to obtain proof of Erdrick's descent.

evidence.quote:
From Tantegel Castle travel 70 leagues
to the south and 40 to the east.

subject: Wynn's Shop
text: A man in Cantlin states that his grandfather Wynn once owned a shop on the east side of Hauksness.

evidence.quote:
My grandfather Wynn once had a shop on the east side of
Hauksness.

subject: Erdrick's Armor
text: A man in Cantlin recounts that Wynn buried something of great value at the foot of a tree behind his shop.

evidence.quote:
Grandfather used to say that his friend, Wynn, had
buried something of great value at the floor of a tree behind his shop.

subject: Village of Kol
text: The desert below the Village of Kol is recommended as an effective place to level up.

evidence.quote: the desert below the Village of Kol

subject: Death
text: Dying causes the hero to lose half of their current gold and respawn at Tantagel Castle.

evidence.quote:
There are only two penalties if you die. One, you get half of
your gold taken away from the time you died, plus you have to walk from
Tantagel Castle to wherever you were at the time of your death

subject: Enemy
text: Weaker enemies tend to run away in battle when the hero's strength significantly outmatches them.

evidence.quote:
Enemies are running from you in battle because basically you are
–too- strong for that enemy!

subject: Old Man
text: An old man behind a desk outside Tantagel Castle refills MP for free, allowing players to repeatedly cast Heal outside battle without paying for an inn.

evidence.quote: In Tantagel Castle, there is a guy, an old man, behind a desk to the right of the entrance all the way at the bottom of the outside of the castle. Talk to him and he'll refill your MP inconspicuously. Now you can use the Heal spell on yourself and then talk to him again to get your MP refilled, and repeat when necessary.

subject: Goldman
text: Defeating a Goldman awards a large sum of gold but grants only 6 experience points.

evidence.quote: While the Goldman is DEFINITELY good to get your cash supply up, he gives you only 6 experience points when you defeat him.

subject: Old Man #2
text: Old Man #2 says, "If thou art cursed, come again."

evidence.quote: Old Man #2 - "If thou art cursed, come again."
